name: longctx64k_v1
rationale: Exploratory 64K setting for Qwen3-0.6B (dev only, no held-out; D6). Qwen3's native context is 32K, so YaRN rope scaling (factor 2, original 32768, as on the Qwen3 model card) is applied: a different model configuration, reported separately from the 32K results.

Pool: distinct LongBench contexts with a 32-64K token chat prompt, not in longctx_v1: GovReport (gov_report, gov_report_e), NarrativeQA and Multi-News (summary prompts in the same 'detailed summary, at least eight paragraphs' form). Contexts above 62K tokens are middle-truncated to 62K (LongBench's own truncation rule) and used only if needed to reach 14 documents.
